sentences.text: Chiayusuchus is an extinct genus of crocodylomorph belonging to the family Stomatosuchidae.
This animal is classified broadly as a reptile.
Fossils of this creature have been discovered in the Xinminbao Group in Gansu, China.
The type species of the genus Chiayusuchus is Chiayusuchus cingulatus.
Although initially classified within Stomatosuchidae, Chiayusuchus is now distinguished by having a different teeth shape. The parent group of the genus remains Stomatosuchidae.
Chiayusuchus lived during the Barremian and Aptian stages of the Early Cretaceous.
However, records in the Paleobiology Database indicate a time range spanning from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian.
